row:
Welcome to Test Prep Central. We help you pass health‑care exams like NCLEX, Pharmacy Tech (PTCB), and medical coding tests such as CPC and CCS. Each week we post mock exams, timed practice tests, and quick study tips. Our questions look like the real test and come with clear, plain‑language answers. Use our videos to practice under real time limits, find weak spots, and lift your score.

Study. Pass. Excel.
